python3 << 'EOF'
import zipfile, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
NS = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
sheet = zin.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
styles = zin.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8')

# --- Compute cached margin values from source data (C=units, D=price, F=cost) ---
root = ET.fromstring(sheet)
vals = {}
for row in root.iter(NS + 'row'):
    rnum = int(row.get('r'))
    d = {}
    for c in row:
        col = re.match(r'[A-Z]+', c.get('r')).group(0)
        v = c.find(NS + 'v')
        if v is not None and v.text:
            d[col] = float(v.text)
    if 'C' in d and 'D' in d and 'F' in d:
        vals[rnum] = d

margins = {}
tot_rev = tot_profit = 0.0
for r in range(2, 10):
    rev = vals[r]['C'] * vals[r]['D']
    profit = rev - vals[r]['C'] * vals[r]['F']
    margins[r] = profit / rev
    tot_rev += rev
    tot_profit += profit
margins[10] = tot_profit / tot_rev

# --- Edit sheet1.xml ---
sheet = sheet.replace('dimension ref="A1:G10"', 'dimension ref="A1:H10"')
sheet = sheet.replace(
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/></cols>',
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="14" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>')

# Header cell
sheet = re.sub(
    r'<row r="1">(.*?)</row>',
    r'<row r="1">\1<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin (%)</t></is></c></row>',
    sheet, count=1, flags=re.S)

# Data + total rows: live formula with cached value
for r in range(2, 11):
    val = f'{margins[r]:.15g}'
    sheet = re.sub(
        rf'<row r="{r}">(.*?)</row>',
        rf'<row r="{r}">\1<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v>{val}</v></c></row>',
        sheet, count=1, flags=re.S)

# --- Edit styles.xml: add 0.0% number format (id 164) + style index 3 ---
styles = styles.replace(
    '<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>')
styles = re.sub(
    r'<cellXfs count="3">(.*?)</cellXfs>',
    r'<cellXfs count="4">\1<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>',
    styles, count=1, flags=re.S)

# --- Write new workbook, preserving all other parts byte-for-byte ---
zout = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for item in zin.infolist():
    data = zin.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
        data = sheet.encode('utf-8')
    elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
        data = styles.encode('utf-8')
    zout.writestr(item, data)
zout.close()
zin.close()

print('Done. Margins:', {k: round(v, 6) for k, v in margins.items()})
EOF
